verdict.rationale: Formant documents a bearer-JWT-secured Admin API and says custom commands can be created through it. Its Agent SDK lets the on-device side receive and respond to commands, and built-in commands such as run_script and publish_ros_topic act on the robot. The command loop is only implied, though: the docs show commands sent from the UI or by events, not issued by an external programmatic client. Nothing shows credentials scoped to a least-privilege role. missing for 10: scoped or least-privilege credential documentation, an explicit API/SDK call that dispatches a command to a robot, an end-to-end AI-agent control example, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an AI agent authenticate with scoped credentials and command a real robot end-to-end through the platform's API or SDK

citations.quote: you can create custom commands via the Formant Admin API
